lines.en: Grandma, it is so hot today!
Yes. The temperature is thirty degrees.
Yesterday was cool. Why is it hot now?
Summer is here. Tomorrow will be hot too.
My head feels warm. Do I have a fever?
Let me measure your temperature.
What is the number?
It is thirty-seven degrees. That's good.
Good! Can I drink some cool water?
Yes. Drink water and wear light clothes.
lines.ko: 네. 물 마시고 가벼운 옷을 입어요.

lines.en: Hello. Please stand here. Let's check your weight.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 여기 서세요. 몸무게를 재 봐요.

lines.en: Is my bag heavy? Should I put it down?
Yes, put it down. The bag is heavy.
What is my weight, Doctor?
It is not high. That is fine.
Last year it was more.
You are lighter now. Do you walk a lot?
Yes. I walk every morning when it is cool.
Great. Now I will measure your temperature.
Thank you, Doctor. The room is warm and nice.
